description: Sites de refuges en cas d'alerte tsunami is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location of safe refuge sites known to the authorities. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Tsunami Alert Refuge Sites" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Tsunami, sites refuges, Santé et sécurité des personnes. The listing shows 2020-08-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
